concerns.text: Tasks belonging to US1 (T001‑T004, T008, T009) are not independently shippable because the execution task T008 runs the *full* pipeline, which includes tasks from US2‑US5. This violates the requirement that each US block must form an independently‑shippable unit.

Tasks T001 and T002 are marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but share hidden state (the skip‑flag set by T001 that downstream tasks read) and both write to the same log files. This creates an ordering dependency and makes them unsafe for parallel execution.
